plus.note: Five-hour allowance; weekly limits may also apply.

pro.note: No five-hour limit; weekly limits may apply.

free.note: A fixed monthly or other recurring quota window is not confirmed by the official pricing documentation.

go.note: A fixed recurring quota window is not confirmed by the official pricing documentation.

enterprise.note: The plan label does not distinguish flexible credit-based usage from standard limits.

edu.note: The plan label does not distinguish flexible credit-based usage from standard limits.

business.note: The plan label does not distinguish Standard Business from flexible credit-based usage.

team.note: The plan label alone does not establish the current Business billing model or its quota windows.

prolite.note: No official evidence establishes that this plan label has the same quota windows as Pro.

self_serve_business_prolite.note: No official evidence establishes the quota windows associated with this plan label.

self_serve_business_usage_based.note: No official evidence establishes fixed quota windows associated with this plan label.
